[{"insert":"45 Degree Back Extension + Cobra Leg Behind Squat 

Two posterior chain movements that work the hips and glutes from completely different positions. The 45 degree back extension loads the hamstrings and glutes through a controlled arc with the hips fixed on the pad. Lower slowly and drive back up from the hips. The cobra leg behind squat that follows challenges single leg strength and hip mobility in the same session. Keep the back leg low and the front heel planted through the whole rep. Push close to RPE 8-9 on both movements each set.
"}]
